# case: 60-layer-build-confirmed
# desc: a checked-in tooling layer that has not been built is confirmed, built from the runtime-selected base reference, and run in place of the base image
# config: apple-darwin
--- exit ---
0
--- runtime-args ---
== container build ==
--build-arg
BASE_IMAGE=claude-contained:latest
-t
claude-contained-layer:project-<LHASH>-stage-<STAGE>
<PROJ>/.claude-contained/layer

== container image tag ==
claude-contained-layer:project-<LHASH>-stage-<STAGE>
claude-contained-layer:project-<LHASH>

== container image delete --force ==
claude-contained-layer:project-<LHASH>-stage-<STAGE>

== container run ==
--rm
-it
--memory
8g
--name
aic-project-<TIME>
-e
HOST_HOME=<HOME>
-e
HOST_UID=<UID>
-e
HOST_GID=<GID>
-w
<PROJ>
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude-contained/claude,dst=<HOME>/.claude
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.codex,dst=<HOME>/.codex
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.copilot,dst=<HOME>/.copilot
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.gemini,dst=<HOME>/.gemini
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.vibe,dst=<HOME>/.vibe
--mount
type=bind,src=<PROJ>,dst=<PROJ>
-e
TZ=UTC
-e
CLAUDE_CONTAINED_EXPLICIT_ENV_KEYS=TZ
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude/skills,dst=<HOME>/.claude/skills
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude/agents,dst=<HOME>/.claude/agents
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude/commands,dst=<HOME>/.claude/commands
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude/plugins,dst=<HOME>/.claude/plugins
-e
GIT_PROTECT_DIRS=<PROJ>
--dns
1.1.1.1
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude-contained,dst=<HOME>/.claude-contained
claude-contained-layer:project-<LHASH>
/usr/local/bin/shell-run
